SELECT DCTID, DCTROOTTYPE, --字典根类型 DCTFATHTYPE, --字典父类型 DCTLEFTTYPE, --字典子类型 DCTNAME, --字典名 DCTVALUE, --字典值 DCTSORTNO, --排序号 DCTISLEAF, --是否叶子 ECC_IBF_GET_DCTNAME_EX('DAT_YES_NOX', D.DCTISLEAF) AS DCTISLEAF_NM, DCTSTAT, --是否生效 ECC_IBF_GET_DCTNAME_EX('DAT_YES_NOX', D.DCTSTAT) AS DCTSTAT_NM, STAT, --状态 ECC_IBF_GET_DCTNAME_EX('DAT_CHK_SAT', D.STAT) AS STAT_NM FROM T_ECC_DICTIONARY D WHERE 1=1
AND D.STAT <> #{stat}
AND NVL(D.DCTVALUE, '1') = NVL(#{dctValue}, NVL(D.DCTVALUE, '1'))
AND NVL(D.DCTSTAT, '1') = NVL((#{dctStat}, NVL(D.DCTSTAT, '1'))
AND D.DCTROOTTYPE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{dctRootType}),'%')
AND D.DCTFATHTYPE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{dctFathType}),'%')
AND D.DCTLEFTTYPE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{dctLeftType}),'%')
AND D.DCTNAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{dctName}),'%')
ORDER BY D.DCTSORTNO
